poems.title: Night's Whisper
poems.author: Mohanmitra
poems.summary: A tender reflection on love's quiet moments...
poems.content:
In the silence of the night,
When stars dance in celestial light,
Your memory whispers through my soul,
A melody that makes me whole.

Each breath carries your name,
A sweet and burning flame,
In dreams we walk together,
In love, forever and ever.

poems.title: Mountain's Echo
poems.author: Mohanmitra
poems.summary: The timeless dialogue between earth and sky...
poems.content:
Ancient peaks rise to kiss the sky,
Where eagles soar and clouds drift by,
Their ancient wisdom calls to me,
A song of wild and boundless free.

In valleys deep where rivers flow,
The secrets of the ages grow,
Nature's heart beats strong and true,
In shades of gold and endless blue.

poems.title: Life's Canvas
poems.author: Mohanmitra
poems.summary: Painting our existence with colors of experience...
poems.content:
We are artists of our own fate,
Each moment a chance to create,
With colors of joy and strokes of pain,
We paint our dreams again and again.

Some days the canvas burns so bright,
Other days fade into night,
But every stroke, every line,
Makes this precious life of mine.

poems.title: Silent Prayers
poems.author: Mohanmitra
poems.summary: Moments of quiet reflection and inner peace...
poems.content:
In the temple of solitude,
I bow my head in gratitude,
For every tear and every smile,
For walking that sacred mile.

The universe listens when we're still,
When we surrender to the will,
In silence, prayers find their way,
Guiding us through every day.

poems.title: City Lights
poems.author: Mohanmitra
poems.summary: Urban rhythms and the pulse of metropolitan life...
poems.content:
Neon dreams flicker in the dark,
Each window holds a story, a spark,
Million souls rush through the street,
Yet somehow our paths might meet.

In the chaos and the sound,
Home is where love is found,
City lights may fade away,
But memories forever stay.
